title: abad wallah ya zahra
body:
hussain
imam hussain
teen shaaban sadaae qaunain
marhaba salle ala hogaya zahoor e maula hussain
aaghoshe fatema se husain aaghoshe risaalat me aaye
hussain dekh ke nana ko muskurate hain magar ye kya huwa chashme rasoole akram se
khushi ke wakt bhi aansu tapakte jaate hain
sawaal kardiya zehra ne ay mere baba udaas kyun huwe kyun sogwaar hai chehra
kaha rasool ne zehra mai khush huwa
ye tera laal mere deen ko bachaega
mein roya is liye zehra watan se door
pyasa akela ghareeb ye mara jaaega aur us qayaamat me na mein na tum
na ali honge na hasan hoga
na koyi apna na pyara hoga
kinare nehr ke be goro be kafan hoga
tadap ke puchha nabi se hussain ki maa ne ke mere baba uspe kon royega
kaha rasool ne zehra na fikr kar beti
khuda ki samt se maujood ek kabila hai
jo royega taa hashr uska waada hai
jo na hussain ko bhulega na husain usko bhulega
saare jahaan se unki musalsal sada hogi
